title: Debussy, Ravel, Stravinsky and the dream of writing symphonies
summary: Classical listening, studying bass with Rheinschagen, friendship with Spaulding Givens, DownBeat's neglect, and the barrier to black symphonic writers.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
